title: Kakegurui - Compulsive Gambler -
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At elite Hyakkaou Academy, status comes from gambling: students who lose fall into debt and become 'pets' who serve others, with futures dictated by 'life schedules'. Transfer student Yumeko Jabami, who gambles for the thrill rather than money, beats cheaters and disrupts the hierarchy run by student council president Kirari Momobami. Yen Press publishes the manga; Common Sense Media rates the anime 15+.
life_message: It treats risk and the thrill of the gamble as life's highest pleasure while exposing a cruel, rigged hierarchy.

content.note: Bets causing physical harm: an eye gouged out, Russian roulette with a loaded gun (Common Sense Media, anime; AniList Death Game signal).
Psychological intimidation and ruinous stakes (Common Sense Media; AniList Psychological genre).
Characters shown aroused by gambling, moaning, touching themselves (Common Sense Media, anime; MangaDex suggestive).
Strong profanity in the anime; manga level to verify (Common Sense Media).
Database flags drugs; Common Sense Media found none in the anime (to verify).
Bullying and humiliation of 'pets'; self-harm bets (Common Sense Media; AniList Bullying and Slavery tags).
Compulsive gambling, cheating and manipulation as core appeal (Common Sense Media; AniList Gambling tag).
Wealth and idol culture at the academy (AniList Idol and Economics tags).

dominant: Hedonism (thrill of risk), Might makes right critiqued (council hierarchy), Expressive individualism

winners_losers: Yumeko wins by embracing risk and exposing cheats, the council's rigid hierarchy loses ground, and pets remain victims. Sympathy goes to the thrill-seeker over both the powerful and the cautious.
